text: INTERPRETER frame and closure taint on the sealed instantiation only: call_fn_in_general and the closure call become const-generic frames (call_fn_frame / call_closure_frame::<T>); call_fn_common (plain entries only, and FnEntry::new now takes seal.active so no entry of a sealed run is plain) binds with 0. A frame binds its parameters with the arguments' taint plus pc (t_params), saves and restores the caller's pc/sticky (FrameCtl), reads taint.ret or taint.last at exit (t_body) and leaves entry|body|sticky in acc (t_frame_exit); refinement predicates, the postcondition, goal_met (ALL when a goal search ran) and struct-refinement predicates carry the frame's taints. A closure's capture cell becomes a typed Captures (bindings plus one taint per binding, sealed run only) moved by the lend, copied by the copy path and written back (TaintPort-5). t_loop_pc after builtin callbacks, goal evaluations and scheduler fibers; t_provenance_write at the zoned-call provenance writes. Unsealed: same code via ::<false>; not PCI-reviewed; every sealed run is still refused (SEAL_RUNTIME_COMPLETE = false)
